title: Quick Portuguese Beef Skillet
description: A flavorful and quick beef skillet dish inspired by Portuguese cuisine.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until browned. Transfer to a plate and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil.
Add the onion, bell pepper, and garlic. Cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the tomato, Portuguese skillet seasoning, and Worcestershire sauce. Cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Return the beef to the skillet and stir to combine with the vegetables and sauce.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
Cook time may vary based on desired level of doneness for the beef.
